Subject: CloudPort marketplace integration — sync: agenda & invite

Hi Elliot / CloudPort team,

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical sync on the marketplace connector. I booked a 45-minute slot for Thu 30 Jul at 10:00 PT. Attached is a short agenda and a prep checklist so we can make the most of the call.

Draft agenda (attached):
- 5m intros & goals
- 15m data flow and auth model
- 15m runtime/latency expectations + KV/cache considerations
- 10m next steps and action items

Can you confirm you have the invite and that the right team is on the call? If that time doesn't work, let me know alternative windows.

Attachments: agenda-cloudport.pdf

Thanks,
Laura Bennett

Hi Elliot / CloudPort,

We were on the line for the marketplace integration sync at 10:00 PT but didn't see any CloudPort attendees join. We waited ~15 minutes in case of delays.

No worries — things happen. Would you be able to propose two alternative 45-minute windows in the next 72 hours? For efficiency, options that work well for us are:
- Fri 31 Jul, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Fri 31 Jul, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Mon 3 Aug, 11:00–11:45 PT

If you prefer, here's a short poll link to pick a slot: https://doodle.com/cloudport-redwood-sync (or just reply with times).

We have the same agenda and the prep doc attached for quick reference.

Laura

Can we take one of these slots instead?
- Fri 31 Jul, 11:00–11:45 ET (08:00 PT)
